paper.title_en: Plasmon Collapse in a Directional Strange Metal
paper.abstract_en: Strange metals are widespread in strongly correlated quantum matter and closely intertwined with high-temperature superconductivity and quantum criticality, yet their microscopic charge dynamics remain fundamentally unresolved. Whether well-defined collective modes survive in an incoherent electronic fluid or dissolve into overdamped continua remains intensely debated. Here, employing high-momentum-resolution inelastic electron scattering complemented by direction-resolved transport, we show that the van der Waals compound $\mathrm{MoOCl}_2$, a "bad" metal known to host unusually "good" plasmons, exhibits a striking dichotomy in electronic coherence and charge dynamics. Transport reveals coherent Fermi liquid behavior along one in-plane crystallographic axis and an incoherent strange metal response along the orthogonal axis. This dichotomy extends directly to the charge response. The Fermi liquid direction supports a well-defined, long-lived plasmon, whereas the strange metal direction exhibits an overdamped excitation that progressively loses its collective character with increasing momentum. Beyond a critical momentum ($q_c$ $\approx$ 0.008 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}^{-1}$), the mode undergoes a reversal into negative dispersion and ultimately collapses into a broad, nearly featureless continuum with a robust high-energy boundary ($E_c$ $\approx$ 1.75 eV). Remarkably, thickness-dependent measurements show that both $q_c$ and $E_c$ remain nearly unchanged despite substantial modifications of Coulomb screening, revealing them as intrinsic scales of incoherent charge density fluctuations. These results establish a unique single-material platform in which coherent and incoherent electronic states are partitioned into in-plane orthogonal channels, and demonstrate that incoherent electronic fluids retain intrinsically structured charge dynamics beyond the quasiparticle paradigm.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究方向性奇异金属中集体等离激元模式的崩塌，直接关联强关联量子物质中非相干电荷动力学这一核心问题，属于凝聚态全息对偶研究范畴。摘要清晰地提出了明确的研究问题、使用高动量分辨非弹性电子散射与方向分辨输运相结合的方法、并给出了含临界动量与能量边界的定量结果，还通过厚度依赖测量探讨了库仑屏蔽的作用，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，新意在于单材料中相干与非相干通道的对比平台。
decision.title_zh: 方向性奇异金属中的等离激元崩塌
decision.abstract_zh: 奇异金属广泛存在于强关联量子物质中，并与高温超导和量子临界性紧密交织，然而其微观电荷动力学在根本上仍未得到解决。明确定义的集体模式究竟能在非相干电子流体中存活，还是溶解为过阻尼连续谱，仍然是激烈争论的问题。在此，我们结合高动量分辨非弹性电子散射与方向分辨输运测量，表明范德华化合物 $\mathrm{MoOCl}_2$——一种已知具有异常“好”等离激元的“坏”金属——在电子相干性与电荷动力学方面展现出惊人的二分性。输运测量揭示出沿一个面内晶轴方向为相干的费米液体行为，而沿正交轴方向为非相干的奇异金属响应。这种二分性直接延伸到电荷响应中。费米液体方向支持一个明确定义的、长寿命的等离激元，而奇异金属方向则表现出一种过阻尼激发，其集体特征随动量增加而逐渐丧失。超过临界动量（$q_c$ $\approx$ 0.008 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}^{-1}$）后，该模式逆转为负色散，并最终坍缩为具有稳健高能边界（$E_c$ $\approx$ 1.75 eV）的宽泛且几乎无特征的连续谱。值得注意的是，厚度依赖测量显示，尽管库仑屏蔽发生了实质性改变，$q_c$ 与 $E_c$ 仍几乎保持不变，揭示出它们是非相干电荷密度涨落的内禀标度。这些结果建立了一个独特的单材料平台，其中相干与非相干电子态被分割到面内正交通道中，并表明非相干电子流体在准粒子范式之外仍保留内禀结构化的电荷动力学。
